entries.55dc316dca7a2581: NANKAI CHEMICAL COMPANY,LIMITED was founded in 1906 and is a chemical manufacturer headquartered in Nishi-ku, Osaka. The group comprises 3 consolidated subsidiaries and 2 equity-method affiliates, and consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 319.
entries.651448dfebe8e1a2: This business is conducted by consolidated subsidiary NM Salt Co., Ltd., which processes solar salt imported from Australia and Mexico and manufactures and sells salt for food use and for preventing road freezing. It sells to umeboshi (pickled plum) processors in southern Wakayama Prefecture, food manufacturers across Japan, and organizations that maintain roads, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,083 million.
